QuickCart Privacy Policy

1. We collect your name, email address and phone number to create your account and send you order updates.

2. By using the app, you consent to the collection, use and sharing of your personal data as described in this policy.

3. To withdraw consent, you must send a signed letter by registered post to our registered office, and withdrawal takes effect after 60 days.

4. We also process your data on the basis of our legitimate interests, such as analytics and product improvement.

5. We protect your data using encryption and access controls.

6. We are not responsible for any unauthorised access to, or hacking of, your personal data.

7. We may retain your personal data indefinitely, at our sole discretion.

8. Questions about this policy can be sent to our privacy team at privacy@quickcart.in.

9. We will respond to any grievance within 30 days of receiving it.

10. You may ask us to correct or delete your personal data.

11. Our services are not directed to children under 13.

12. We show personalised ads to all users, including children, based on their activity in the app.

13. Premium subscriptions can be cancelled only by calling our helpline during business hours with 30 days' notice.

14. After the 7-day free trial, your plan automatically converts to a paid plan and your card is charged without further notice.
